dct_description_sm:
Feature layer of Fish Shed locations (Fish Packing Stations) across Manitoba.  
  
  This feature layer - which is used in the Manitoba Commercial Fishing Industry Map  and the Manitoba Commercial Fishing Industry Application - shows the Fish Shed locations (Fish Packing Stations) across Manitoba. This is a point layer that includes the name of the Fish Shed.
